name: depth-flip-text
title: Depth Flip Text
description: Vault-themed perspective text flip with staggered character motion and optional crossfade.

props.name: phrases
props.description: Phrases that cycle through the perspective flip.

props.name: textColor
props.description: Text color for both the current and incoming phrase.

props.name: loop
props.description: Restarts the phrase sequence after the last entry.

props.name: holdDuration
props.description: Delay before each phrase begins its flip transition.

props.name: charStagger
props.description: Delay between each character beginning its motion.

props.name: useOpacityTransition
props.description: Fades outgoing and incoming characters during the flip.

props.name: scrub
props.description: Links the first flip transition to scroll progress instead of autoplay.

props.name: scrollStart
props.description: ScrollTrigger start value used when scrub is enabled.

props.name: scrollEnd
props.description: ScrollTrigger end value used when scrub is enabled.
